title: Final ensemble: ResNet18d@288-train + ResNet34d, inference 352/320, balance, SIFT inlier>=5
hypothesis: A model trained at 288 (strongest single OOF) and a second architecture at different inference sizes should ensemble well.

results.name: ensemble OOF with balance (no SIFT)
results.note: selected greedily on the same OOF: optimistic

findings: Public 0.87012: +0.038 over EXP-023 (0.83262). The change bundles new members (EXP-018/020) with inference 352/320; no intermediate submission separated them.
The no-SIFT version of this ensemble (best_eval_submission.csv, sha fed2db49f1ef13ff) was never submitted, so the SIFT step's marginal value on top of it is unmeasured.
limitations: OOF is optimistic (members and resolution picked on it).
Public score covers only part of test; private may differ.
